rules: LOP3.LUT register form: constant, single-source, and / or / xor / majority / mux / mixed truth tables, RZ and repeated sources
reference: Inputs w0=0x00000000, w1=0xffffffff, w2=0x55555555, w3=0xaaaaaaaa, w4=0x80000001, w5=0x12345678, w6=0x0f0f00ff, w7=0xdeadbeef; every other word i is the guard ((i+1)*0x9e3779b9+0x31415926) mod 2^32. LOP/LOP32I: ~ inverts that source, then AND/OR/XOR, PASS_B returns the (inverted) B; LOP/LOP3 immediates are signed 20-bit, sign-extended; LOP3.LUT bit = (lut >> (a*4+b*2+c)) & 1 (PTX lop3 convention, A=0xF0 B=0xCC C=0xAA); RZ = 0; c[0][*] = 0 (framework zero C0). w8 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0x00) = 0x00000000; w9 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0xff) = 0xffffffff; w10 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0xf0) = 0x0f0f00ff; w11 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0xcc) = 0x12345678; w12 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0xaa) = 0xdeadbeef; w13 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0x80) = 0x02040068; w14 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0xfe) = 0xdfbffeff; w15 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0x96) = 0xc396e868; w16 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0xe8) = 0x1e2d16ff; w17 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0xca) = 0xd2a4be78; w18 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0x6a) = 0xdca9be97; w19 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0x0f) = 0xf0f0ff00; w20 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0x3c) = 0x1d3b5687; w21 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0x01) = 0x20400100; w22 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0xb4) = 0x0f1f40ef; w23 = LOP3.LUT(w6, w5, w7, lut=0x1e) = 0xd1b2fe00; w24 = LOP3.LUT(RZ, w5, RZ, lut=0xcc) = 0x12345678; w25 = LOP3.LUT(w7, w7, w7, lut=0x96) = 0xdeadbeef; words 26-63 unchanged.
